def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); sep=2
    rs=[i for i in range(h) if all(x==sep for x in g[i])]
    cs=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==sep for i in range(h))]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out=[]; s=0
        for x in cuts+[n]:
            if x>s: out.append((s,x))
            s=x+1
        return out
    rr=spans(h,rs); cc=spans(w,cs)
    bg=max(set(v for row in g for v in row if v!=sep),key=lambda x:sum(y==x for row in g for y in row))
    mark=next(x for x in set(v for row in g for v in row if v!=sep) if x!=bg)
    return [[1 if sum(g[i][j]==mark for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d))>=2 else bg for c,d in cc] for a,b in rr]
print(transform(g))
